description: This is a Java source file establishing a base class for integration tests within the Apache Fineract project. It contains setup configurations, utility methods, and test helpers for conducting comprehensive loan-related integration tests. The class manages test accounts, accounts configuration, loan product creation, verification methods, and permission testing, enabling structured testing of loan functionalities.

classes.name: BaseLoanIntegrationTest
classes.description: An abstract base class for integration testing loan functionalities in the Fineract platform. It provides setup methods, accounts configuration, verification helpers, and permission testing utilities to facilitate comprehensive loan-related tests.
